description: Block until a request matching the filters arrives on a capture log, then return it. The perfect assertion step: trigger an event, await its arrival, inspect the payload. Only matches NEW requests from the moment of the call. The session keeps running afterwards.

path.description: Only match paths containing this substring

status.description: Only match this response status (e.g. 200 or 2xx)

timeoutSeconds.description: Give up after this many seconds (default 60, max 300)

name: request_await
title: Wait for a request to arrive
